### Completion Report: Work Order 1 — Op Log (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo1`)

#### Summary of Deliverables

1. **Op Models and Types** ([`internal/core/ops/op.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go)):
   - Defined [`OpType`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L10) enum: `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`.
   - Defined standard provenance source constants: `turn-note`, `sidecar`, `seed`, `pa`, `human`, `consolidation`.
   - Defined [`Op`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L32) and [`OpBatch`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L43) structs matching the v2 design schema.
   - Added [`NewBatchID`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L51) helper generating ULIDs using `github.com/oklog/ulid/v2`.

2. **Validation Rules** ([`internal/core/ops/validate.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go)):
   - [`ValidateOp`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L10): Validates each op according to type-specific constraints (`add` requiring text/entry ID/scope, `amend` requiring fields/entry ID, `supersede` requiring `new_entry_id` and `text`, `retire` requiring `reason`, `move` requiring `to_dossier`, `split` requiring scope, `new_dossiers` list and `entry_moves` map).
   - [`ValidateBatch`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L91): Validates schema version (>= 1), non-empty batch ID, and validates every contained op.

3. **Op File I/O** ([`internal/core/ops/writer.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/writer.go) & [`internal/core/ops/reader.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/reader.go)):
   - [`Writer.Write`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/writer.go#L28): Atomically writes indented JSON (2 spaces) into `<baseDir>/<yyyy-mm>/<batch-id>.json`.
   - [`Reader.ReadBatch`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/reader.go#L24): Reads, unmarshals, and validates batch files from relative or absolute paths.

4. **Op Log Iterator** ([`internal/core/ops/iterator.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go)):
   - [`Reader.Iterate`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L143): Yields batches using Go 1.23 `iter.Seq2[*OpBatch, error]` walking month directories in chronological order, then batches in ULID order.
   - [`Reader.IterateAfter`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L148): Yields batches occurring after a given batch ID for incremental processing.
   - [`Reader.IterateBefore`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L154): Git commit time-cut mechanism resolving commit timestamp via `git log -1 --format=%cI <commit>` and yielding batches created before that cutoff.

5. **v1 Events Store Retirement & Migration** ([`internal/core/ops/migrate.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/migrate.go)):

   - Marked [`internal/core/events/doc.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/events/doc.go#L3) as deprecated: `// Deprecated: use internal/core/ops instead. Will be removed in WO5.`.

6. **Tests** ([`internal/core/ops/ops_test.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed42/internal/core/ops/ops_test.go)):
   - Full suite testing all op type validations, batch validations, round-trip read/writes, chronological multi-month iteration, `IterateAfter`, `IterateBefore` with real git commits, `MigrateV1Events`, and compatibility validation against all real batches in `.memory/ops/`.
